coordinate_contract.native_asset_axes: X wall thickness inward, -Y facade edge tangent, Z up
coordinate_contract.houdini_module_axes: X thickness, -Z facade edge tangent, Y up
coordinate_contract.orientation: _quaternion(_rotation(edge_tangent)); native local +X maps pad interior and native -Y maps edge direction
coordinate_contract.position_anchor: Exact measured min X, max Y and min Z compensated so module envelope begins at geographic edge/start and corrected pad elevation
coordinate_contract.scale_policy: Whole assets stay 1:1; assembly bays alone use along-wall scale 0.5..1.5 and vertical scale 0.65..1.1. Door stays 1:1.

assembly_rules.footprints: CCW simple single-ring closed geographic pad, convex or concave; no changes to geographic boundary; collinear and duplicate points conditioned without displacement
assembly_rules.floors: Deterministic story count near 3.2m, exact source height retained; measured 4m native bay height scaled to complete story; full footprint closed floor slab at each story and roof slab at source top
assembly_rules.facades: 4m native window bays; measured 2m/1m plain fillers; bounded residual width distributed into whole bays or fillers; native envelopes must stay inside full concave footprint
assembly_rules.corners: Measured thickness with angle-derived convex trim; generated closed corner strips clipped to footprint triangles close each edge without extending outside the geographic pad
assembly_rules.entrance: Ground story longest usable edge reserves exact native Steeldoor width/height; wall intervals on both sides plus generated lintel; no backing wall across door opening; native door unscaled
assembly_rules.terrain: Every footprint vertex and ground module envelope corner sampled on the explicit final corrected heightfield; all contact samples must be within 4cm of corrected pad base
assembly_rules.substitution: Only complete supported records remove original shells; original shells remain for unsupported footprints/heights/contact, with exact reason and source ID
assembly_rules.ledger: Both instances and nonbuilding_instances include all building_module records; expected_mesh_counts includes native module paths; assembly building count is separate from whole-building and native module counts
